homes.area_note: Sales are tied to Trinidad through OTR assessment sub-areas Trinidad A, B and C and Brentwood B in OTR's Integrated Tax System Public Extract, not through the DC Health planning-area boundary used elsewhere on this site, because the tax extract has no coordinates. The two areas overlap but do not match exactly. Fit with the Trinidad boundary, measured this run by tax square (a square counts as inside if any DC address point on it falls inside the DC Health polygon, so edge squares make these upper bounds; measured 2026-11-03): 100% of the 3,538 house and condo parcels in the OTR area(s) sit on squares inside the boundary, and 94% of house and condo parcels on in-boundary squares belong to the OTR area(s).
homes.sales_note: Only deeds OTR codes "Market Sale" at $75,000 or more are counted (same filter as the prototypes); foreclosures, buyer=seller transfers, speculative, tax-deed, unusual and multi-parcel sales are excluded. "house" = row, semi-detached and detached (use codes 011-013); "condo" = use codes 016-017. Dates are deed sale dates; deeds reach the extract a few weeks after closing, so the newest weeks undercount. The extract keeps only each parcel's most recent sale, so a home that resold within 24 months counts once, in its later window. "Assessed" is OTR's current total assessment (NEWTOTAL), which may postdate the sale. Building area and bedrooms are from CAMA Residential (houses only).
homes.by_month_basis: houses only; calendar months, the last one in progress; median null when under 3 sales

curb.freshness_note: DDOT TOPS occupancy layer, checked 2026-11-03: newest permit issued 2026-11-02, newest record update 2026-11-02, so the layer is current to within a day or two.

trees.empty_boxes_note: Counted from the layer's tree-box status (TBOX_STAT). 'Open' = an empty box ready to plant (55). Not counted: 'Proposed' = planting scheduled (308), 'Conflict'/'Utility' = empty but blocked (41), 'Retired' = box removed (254). 'total' is boxes with status 'Plant' whose condition is not Dead.

streets.service_note: Median days from request to closure for requests opened in the last 12 months and already closed, computed from request and resolution timestamps only (exact here; citywide from server-side quantiles). When the window spans two yearly layers the citywide median is merged from each layer's quantiles (accurate to a few percent). Requests still open are excluded, which biases recent months toward faster closes, equally here and citywide.

archive.note: Clips are machine-read text (OCR) from scanned Evening Star pages on the Library of Congress's Chronicling America, lightly cleaned (line-break hyphens rejoined, stray symbols removed); misspellings are the scanner's. Newspapers this old are public domain. Each clip links to its page at loc.gov. Clips that mention race, covenants, deed restrictions or slurs are skipped automatically (keyword list: race, races, racial, colored, coloured, negro, negroes, white only, whites only, for whites, white people, white persons, white residents, caucasian, segregation, segregated, covenant, covenants, restricted, restriction, restrictions, plus a list of slurs), because they need an editor's context; legal notices and lists of private individuals are skipped too. This week 1 otherwise usable clip was held back by that screen.
